title: Establishment of Central Consumer Protection Authority

content.scenario: The Central Government wants to regulate unfair trade practices and protect consumer rights. It needs to set up a dedicated authority to oversee these matters.
content.outcome: The Central Government shall establish a Central Consumer Protection Authority by notification, with effect from a specified date. This Authority will regulate matters relating to violation of consumer rights, unfair trade practices, and false or misleading advertisements, and promote, protect, and enforce consumer rights as a class.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Consumer Protection Authority?
How will the Central Government establish the Central Consumer Protection Authority?
What are the powers of the Central Consumer Protection Authority?
